description: Type a TypeScript orders-report client end to end: introduce User/Order/OrderLine interfaces and a Paginated<T> shape, route every call through a generic request<T> so methods return concrete Promise types, type the error path, and leave no ': any' in src/client.ts or src/models.ts so the module is strict-clean and importable.

criteria: src/client.ts and src/models.ts define exported interfaces for the resource shapes, route every request through a generic private request<T> so getUser and getOrder return Promise<User> and Promise<Order> while the listings return Promise<Paginated<T>>, unwrap a typed error body on non-2xx responses, export the ApiClient class and the shapes so other modules can import them, and contain no ': any' annotation anywhere, with the README untouched.
